notes.kinds: Every sticker has one action (a moment stories cue: {snail:live}, held on its pause frame with {snail:live hold} and carried on with {snail:live resume}) and one move (its walk, hop, crawl, flight or sprout; entrances and go cues play it). A sticker that gets about more than one way has a second move after its usual one (the ladybug crawls, and flies: {ladybug:go on flower by fly}); flies marks a flight, on where a story that brings it in that way lands it.
notes.sheets: Each sheet is one API call drawing a grid of frames; the previous sheet is passed back as a reference so the next one continues it. 12 frames per 3072x2304 sheet (4x3) gives 768 px cells; an action is two sheets (24 frames), a move one.
notes.smooth: About 10-12 frames a second: 0.08-0.1 s per frame while something moves, longer holds only on the poses the eye should rest on. Each frame a small step on from the one before.
notes.hold: Seconds per frame, one entry per frame across all sheets (an action's first and last frames are the dissolve from and back to the still sticker; a move's frame 1 is the rest pose it never plays).
notes.pause: An action's pause frame (1-based) is a still pose worth staying in (hidden in the shell, asleep, watching the fly): it ends sheet 1 and sheet 2 starts from it, so both sheets have a rest pose or a shared pose for scale.
notes.motion: Gentle by design: nothing fast, nothing that reaches far from the sticker. A move is drawn in place, as on a treadmill; the app slides it across the scene at stride sticker widths per loop.
notes.register: base (actions; feet or shell planted), feet (walks: bottom on one ground line, matched sideways), body (flights, or an action whose base changes shape — the snail's shell alone once the body is in).
